title: MODULE
description: This RenderWeekly project was to design an open platform for a modular lighting system, where the primary module can be used as a floor-standing lamp, a wall-mounted lamp, and a spotlight, among many other things, through reflection.

brief.label: Brief
brief.text: A RenderWeekly project: an open platform for a modular lighting system.

brief.label: Design response
brief.text: One light module that works as a floor lamp, a wall light or a spotlight, among many other uses, using reflection to change the light.

brief.label: Competition
brief.text: Lighting makers such as Signify, Acuity and WAC Group.
